svg.title: TailSentry: a useful bound, a failed comparison
svg.desc: A current 4096-draw Gaussian delta-gamma estimate is shown separately from frozen research. The primary efficiency ratio is 38.79 versus conditional Sobol, where lower is better. In the missed-mode counterexample, ordinary intervals cover truth in 3 of 512 runs, despite high observed effective sample size. Each square represents one stored run, in original seed order.

g.text: Band: final bound. Gold: known truth 1e−4.
Prefixes do not permit optional stopping.
MSE × elapsed-time ratio; lower is better.
Green: covers truth. One square per run.
Median tail ESS ≈ 18,000; finite bounds abstain.
